title: IntentDiff plugin registry manifest
description: Schema for the official plugin registry (buchochelliq-labs/intentdiff-registry/registry.yaml) that `intentdiff.plugins.hub` fetches. The registry is the root of trust: adding a plugin is a PR whose CI vets it against this schema plus checksum/capability/provenance verification (#95). The known fields mirror the RegistryEntry the client already parses; `trust_tier`, `capabilities`, `abi_target` (#94), and `provenance_manifest_ref` (#89) formalise the trust/compat surface.

version.description: Registry schema version. 1 is the current contract.

plugins.description: Plugins keyed by their package-safe registry name (matches the RegistryEntry name).

plugin_name.description: Package-safe plugin name (mirrors _PLUGIN_NAME_RE in hub.py); never a URL, path, or requirement expression.

dep_hash.description: A pip --require-hashes value: 'sha256:' + lowercase hex digest.

entry.description: One plugin's registry metadata. All fields are optional — the plugin name is the mapping key. Trust is asserted here: an entry with wasm_checksums (and trust_tier 'official') installs verified; an entry without warns as unverified.

source.description: Install source. git: tag/branch/commit ref. pypi: version string.

ref.description: git: tag/branch/commit SHA (default 'main'). pypi: version (e.g. '1.2.3'); empty = latest.

repo.description: Custom git repo URL (git source only). Empty = the official org URL is derived from the name (which also makes is_official true).

description.description: Human-readable one-line summary for the discovery catalog.

wasm_checksums.description: Expected SHA-256 of each bundled .wasm, keyed by filename. Verified on every install. Absent = unverified (install warns).

dep_hashes.description: Approved dependency hashes for plugins that cannot be fully self-contained, keyed by 'package==version'. Passed to pip as --require-hashes; the main package wheel must be included.

allowed_dependencies.description: Reviewed package names (no version) that may appear in dep_hashes besides the main plugin package.

trust_tier.description: official = org-built/scanned, checksums present, installs verified. community = listed but unverified; install warns. Wired to hub.py's is_official / checksum-present-or-warn logic (#95).

capabilities.description: Declared plugin capabilities (e.g. the WIT interfaces implemented), scanned at vetting time.

abi_target.description: The plugin contract / host-utils version the plugin implements (#94). The host refuses a plugin whose abi_target is incompatible with the engine's contract version — caught at resolve time, not instantiation.

provenance_manifest_ref.description: Reference to the plugin's Wasm provenance manifest (#89): filename -> SHA-256 + source commit for every bundled artifact, so downstream consumers can verify provenance.
